stem: During the early twentieth century, which action was taken to address the issues shown in this diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: Labor reformers secured better working conditions through legislation.

options.label: B
options.text: Businesses hired fewer immigrants as laborers.

options.label: C
options.text: Corporations sought greater federal industrial regulations.

options.label: D
options.text: Businesses created monopolies to increase competition among industries.

visual_elements: Factories begin to produce more goods during the Second Industrial Revolution. → • Workers include young women and children. • Workers work long hours. • Workers earn low wages.
